items.html: Even though they are seven kings, they are ten, such as when we say that they are seven halls, when they are actually ten. This is because the first hall consists of the first three Sefirot, and is called the hall of the Holy of Holies. The last hall consists of two, Yesod and Malchut, which is Livnat haSapir [sapphire brick]. So it is here, since they are Yod Sefirot, called seven kings.
